d: Long, flowing magenta hair with blunt-cut bangs frames a youthful face with sharp, narrow magenta eyes. The slender build is dressed in a black, short-sleeved gothic dress featuring a square neckline and a matching black cape with a tattered, star-filled purple lining. The ensemble is completed with black thigh-high stockings with lace trim, black boots, and white gloves, while a long, black ornate staff with a glowing magenta gem is held in hand.
